headline: Adjusted loss in quarter, yet full-year outlook raised
summary_short: Humana's Q3 2026 revenue was $41.2 billion, up 26.1% y/y, with GAAP EPS of $1.33 but an adjusted loss of $0.70 per share; full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to at least $9.50.
summary_long: GAAP EPS of $1.33 compared with $1.62 a year ago, while adjusted EPS swung to a $0.70 loss from $3.24. A $358 million put/call valuation gain lifted GAAP pretax results to $216 million. The Insurance benefit ratio was 93.7%, better than management's 'slightly above 94 percent' view. Year to date, CenterWell Senior Primary Care patients grew 146,800 and Medicaid membership grew 103,600. Full-year adjusted EPS guidance rose to at least $9.50 from at least $9.00; GAAP guidance rose to at least $15.09.
confidence_notes: KPI values come from shard (SEC XBRL / Yahoo) and match the release's GAAP EPS and revenue. Release is the brief EX-99.1; detailed statistical release was not fetched, so segment-level causes are limited. Guidance captured in summary text only; no guidance array written to the shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: Not explained in the release; the brief release only lists GAAP revenue of $41,155M versus $32,649M a year ago.
GAAP EPS was helped by a $2.94 per-share put/call valuation adjustment, offsetting a weak underlying result.
Adjusted result is a loss after excluding the valuation gain, value creation initiative costs and other items; the release points to the detailed release for causes.
Insurance GAAP benefit ratio of 93.7% beat guidance, and management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance while expanding CenterWell and Medicaid footprints.
